Ryan explains how his lifelong interest in fishing helped him create marketing that connected with customers after roughly a dozen other stores failed. That foundation eventually became Beyond Braid, which generated $9.1 million last year and is targeting more than $10 million this year across Amazon, Shopify, and TikTok Shop. Ryan breaks down how each channel supports the business, with Amazon now accounting for the largest share of revenue. He also shares a candid perspective on TikTok Shop, where advertising costs, affiliate commissions, and fulfillment expenses make profitability challenging. For his business, breaking even can still provide value when it generates millions of product impressions and encourages shoppers to discover the brand elsewhere.
